run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T15:04:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by a checkout-path failure that began immediately after the otel-demo/shipping Deployment was rolled out at 15:02:46Z. Every frontend error span in the window is on the checkout route (POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), and that route was clean from 14:19Z until the rollout, then failed completely. In trace 36e4c651c4ab2372d0ad5f57ced69aa6, frontend POST /api/checkout returns 500 from checkout's PlaceOrder (gRPC 13 INTERNAL, message 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'); checkout's HTTP POST to shipping errors, shipping's /get-quote span errors with otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error', and shipping's own outbound child span 'POST ' errors with 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' 10 microseconds later. The rollout created ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (revision 2) whose only observed container-spec difference from the previous ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (revision 1, same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping) is QUOTE_ADDR, changed from 'http://quote:8080' to 'quote:0000'; the quote Service listens on port 8080, and shipping now produces zero successful quote calls while emitting ~273 error spans per 10 minutes on /get-quote. The quote service itself shows no error spans and is no longer reached, and email and payment are never reached because checkout aborts at the shipping quote step. Pods are Running/ready with zero restarts, so no crash, eviction or OOM is involved. The malformed QUOTE_ADDR is the deepest cause the evidence supports; the exact config value cannot be read at runtime beyond the pod template, and the writer of the change is unknown because change history is not integrated.

claims.text: In the 10 minutes ending 2026-11-16T15:17:47Z, frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans are only on the checkout path: 'POST' 274.19, 'POST /api/checkout' 274.19, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 274.19, 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 274.19 (increase over 10m), while every other frontend operation has 0 error increase.

frontend 'POST /api/checkout' error-span increase was exactly 0 in every 5-minute bucket from 14:19:06Z through 15:04:06Z, then 17.78 in the bucket ending 15:09:06Z, 175.56 ending 15:14:06Z and 156.67 at 15:19:06Z, while its non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) increase fell from 144.44 in the bucket ending 15:04:06Z to 0 in all later buckets: checkout started failing between 15:04Z and 15:09Z and now fails entirely.

Trace 36e4c651c4ab2372d0ad5f57ced69aa6 (start 15:13:26Z) shows the failure chain: load-generator POST (http 500) -> frontend-proxy ingress/router frontend egress (500) -> frontend 'POST /api/checkout' (500) -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code 13, message '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500') -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (error, gRPC 13) -> checkout 'HTTP POST' (error) -> shipping '/get-quote' (error, otel.status_description 'Internal Server Error') -> shipping 'POST ' (error, otel.status_description 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))').

shipping's own spans are now 100% errors on its quote path: in the 10 minutes to 15:17:47Z, '/get-quote' STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 'POST ' STATUS_CODE_ERROR each increased 273.14, and in the 5 minutes to the same instant shipping '/get-quote' UNSET, 'POST quote' UNSET and '/ship-order' UNSET were all 0.

The otel-demo shipping Deployment rolled out during the incident window: ScalingReplicaSet 'Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1' at 15:02:46Z and 'Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0' at 15:02:53Z, ReplicaSet SuccessfulCreate pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (15:02:46Z), container Started (15:02:53Z), and Killing/SuccessfulDelete of pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q (15:02:53Z) - a controller rollout, not damage.

The rollout is configuration-only: ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (deployment revision 1) has QUOTE_ADDR='http://quote:8080' and ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (revision 2) has QUOTE_ADDR='quote:0000'; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping with identical ports, resources and all other env vars (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, OTEL_COLLECTOR_NAME, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE, SHIPPING_PORT=8080, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES). The live Deployment's template carries QUOTE_ADDR='quote:0000'.

The quote Service in otel-demo exposes port 8080 (port 8080 -> targetPort 8080, ClusterIP, selector opentelemetry.io/name=quote), so the new QUOTE_ADDR value 'quote:0000' names a port that the quote Service does not expose, in addition to dropping the http:// scheme.

quote service emitted no STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans at all in the 73-minute window (all of its spans were STATUS_CODE_UNSET: POST /getquote 979.62, calculate-quote 979.62, {closure} 979.62), and quote produced 0 spans for all three operations in the 5 minutes to 15:17:47Z - shipping is no longer reaching it.

The involved pods are Running and ready with zero restarts: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn (started 2026-11-16T15:02:46Z, container shipping ready, restartCount 0), frontend-675fd7b5c5-lmznt and checkout-5dccddf8bb-7gfz7 (started 14:26:14Z, ready, 0 restarts).

Measured frontend error-span share at 15:17:47Z was 0.0519 (sum(rate(error spans[10m])) / sum(rate(all frontend spans[10m]))), which does not match the alert annotation's 'current: 1.7777777777777777'; the alert's own expression/metric is therefore not verified (see gaps).

The visible shipping container log lines from 15:08:30Z to 15:11:47Z are repeated 'Requesting quote' entries (339 lines read, newest 120 shown); the pod has no previous container instance, so no pre-rollout log stream exists for comparison.

The configuration regression in the shipping Deployment is the cause of the frontend alert: QUOTE_ADDR changed from 'http://quote:8080' to 'quote:0000' (no scheme, port that the quote Service does not expose), so shipping's outbound quote request URI cannot be parsed, producing 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' within 10 microseconds, a 500 on shipping /get-quote, gRPC 13 INTERNAL in checkout PlaceOrder, and 500 responses on frontend POST /api/checkout. Consistent facts: the only observed pod-template delta is QUOTE_ADDR; failures start after the 15:02:46Z rollout; shipping's failing outbound span has an empty target name 'POST ' instead of the earlier successful 'POST quote'; and no successful quote call from shipping has occurred since.

The quote service is not the failing dependency: it shows no error spans in the 73-minute window, its earlier calls from shipping were all STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and it now receives no calls at all - the failure happens before any request leaves shipping.

In the failing trace, checkout's other dependencies succeeded: oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (x2) and oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (x2) all recorded rpc.grpc.status_code '0', and currency spans recorded otel.status_code OK - the break is isolated to the shipping quote call.

An email or payment service failure is not the cause despite the message text 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500': the failing trace contains no email and no payment span, and email and payment each had 0 spans (all status codes) in the 10 minutes to 15:17:47Z because checkout aborts at the shipping quote step before reaching them.

The small flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream error counts on ad (1.05), recommendation (1.05) and fraud-detection (1.05) spans per 10 minutes are not the cause of the frontend alert: frontend's calls to ad and recommendation show 0 error increase in the same window, and those spans are outside the checkout path.

Crash, OOMKill or eviction of the shipping pod is not the cause: shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no previous container instance, and the only pod lifecycle events in the window are the Deployment's own ScalingReplicaSet/SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete/Started/Scheduled entries at 15:02:46-15:02:53Z.

Revert the shipping Deployment's QUOTE_ADDR to the revision-1 value 'http://quote:8080' (the quote Service's exposed port 8080) and roll out, then verify shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST ' error spans and frontend 'POST /api/checkout' 500s stop; no code or image change is needed since the image digest reference is unchanged (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping in both revisions).

gaps: No alerting rule named RequestErrorRate exists in this Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules returned no_data), and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count/rpc_* series were not returned by get_metric_names in the window, so the alert's exact expression and the reported 'current: 1.7777777777777777' cannot be reproduced; the error evidence used here is traces_span_metrics_calls_total error spans.
The change_history integration is not available, so who or what changed shipping's QUOTE_ADDR (Helm release 'otel-demo' annotation only shows the release, not the change author) is unknown.

Kubernetes state metrics are absent from this Prometheus (get_metric_names {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no_data; kube_pod_owner and kube_replicaset_owner queries returned no_data), so Kubernetes findings rest on point-in-time API snapshots and windowed events, not on historical object state.

Shipping container logs show only 'Requesting quote' lines and a filtered error query returned no_data, so logs neither confirm nor explain the invalid-URI failure; runtime env of the running container could not be read beyond the pod template (secrets cannot be read), so the value actually used at runtime is inferred from the ReplicaSet/Deployment template.

A 1-minute-step error series (increase(...[1m])) returned sparse all-zero points that contradict the 5-minute and 10-minute views; 1-minute-resolution error onset within 15:02:46-15:09Z is therefore not precisely dated.

Downstream or customer impact beyond the failing checkout route (e.g. abandoned orders, revenue) was not measured; only frontend/checkout/shipping/frontend-proxy error spans and the load-generator's 500 response were observed.
next_steps: Reconcile the RequestErrorRate rule definition (its metric and lookback) with Alertmanager, since it is not loaded in this Prometheus and its 1.7777 reading does not match the 0.0519 frontend error-span share measured here.

Use change history (git/Helm/CI) to identify the commit or values change that set shipping QUOTE_ADDR to 'quote:0000' at 15:02:46Z and add a config validation or smoke test for the quote address format.

After reverting QUOTE_ADDR, watch traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="shipping",span_name="/get-quote",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} and frontend 'POST /api/checkout' error spans to confirm recovery.
